evidence.observation: Steady monotonic rise during growth from ~3.00 to 3.15 Torr (k=21→25) with Ar flow held at 100 sccm
Flow stable at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
T tracks 750 °C setpoint with plausible heater power ~44%
Sensor not installed; growth-stage atmosphere purity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a flow-step / pump-isolation pressure test) to distinguish an air in-leak from partial exhaust restriction as the cause of the pressure drift.
